prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1364; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Pearland, Texas, I observed a rear-end collision involving two passenger vehicles in the left lane of the roadway. Driver 1 stated the vehicle ahead had slowed abruptly and that Driver 1 was unable to stop in time. Driver 2 stated the vehicle had been stopped briefly in traffic when struck from behind. Damage was consistent with a moderate impact to the rear of Driver 2's vehicle and the front of Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger in Driver 2's vehicle was also present and was evaluated at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported by EMS for further evaluation. Driver 1 was observed holding the wrist in a guarded position and reported that the injury was consistent with a fracture. Both vehicles were driven from the roadway after documentation and were not disabled. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of traffic conditions and witness statements.
